name: Jiangsu Rainbow Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Rainbow Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. engages in equipment manufacturing and environmental protection businesses in China. The company operates through Ship and Offshore Engineering Equipment; and Material Lifting and Handling Equipment segments. Its Ship and Offshore Engineering Equipment segment includes special transport vessels, offshore vessels, offshore wind power foundations, LNG fuel tanks, ship hatch covers, tied bridges, etc. The Material Lifting and Handling Equipment segment offers industrial lifting, handling, loading/unloading, and bulk material conveying solutions.
